Where do I begin?

Keep what you know, what you tried, and what helped. No model or account is required.

Each tab keeps its own draft and search scope. Export a file before closing this tab. Earlier device drafts are preserved.

Choose what you want to find, give your search a name, enter your name or handle, then choose Start search notes. You can then add a clue, search, result, or question.
